tasks.label: deploy-hostinger
args: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned; $passFile="${workspaceFolder}\tmp_deploy_api_update.ps1"; if (-not $env:FTP_PASS -and (Test-Path $passFile)) { $line = Get-Content $passFile | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\$ftpPass\s*=' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($line) { $parts = $line.Split(""""); if ($parts.Count -ge 2) { $env:FTP_PASS = $parts[1] } } }; if (-not $env:FTP_PASS) { throw "FTP_PASS no definido. Define FTP_PASS en el entorno." }; & "${workspaceFolder}\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1"; python ftp_upload.py
